shadowSentences: I enjoy reading books in my free time.
My favorite season is autumn because of the colors.
Learning a new language can be quite challenging.
I often go hiking on weekends with my friends.
Cooking a meal from scratch is very rewarding for me.
Traveling to new places helps me learn about different cultures.
Listening to music can improve my mood and focus.
Volunteering at local shelters is an important part of my life.
Spending time in nature has many benefits for mental health.
Having a daily routine helps me stay productive and organized.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel experiences.
questions: Q1: Can you share a memorable trip you took recently?
Q2: What challenges did you face during your travels?
Q3: How do you think traveling impacts a person's perspective on life?
Q4: What advice would you give someone planning their first trip abroad?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about hobbies and interests.
questions: Q1: What is a hobby you enjoy and why?
Q2: Have you encountered any difficulties in pursuing this hobby?
Q3: In your opinion, how important are hobbies for personal well-being?
Q4: What recommendations do you have for someone looking to find a new hobby?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about study strategies.
questions: Q1: What study methods have worked best for you?
Q2: What obstacles do you face when trying to study effectively?
Q3: How do you think effective study habits can influence academic success?
Q4: What advice would you give to someone struggling with their study routine?
